```{r setup, include=F}
# Load functions

library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(geosphere)
library(sp)
library(magrittr)
library(foreach)

dir.create(here::here("output_data/platform_proximity"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

In this script we first calculate the single closest passage by an offshore petroleum facility (point) for each foraging trip in our dataset. We then calculate all the potential exposures (passage within the light or oil spill footprint of an offshore petroleum facility point) for each foraging trip and determine whether these passages occurred under vulnerable conditions - at night in any behavioural state for exposure to light, at any time of day while the bird was in the 'on-water' behavioural state for exposure to oil. 

We identify and summarize cases of multiple exposures and calculate the proportion of exposed trips per bird. Where possible, we summarize these results by colony and breeding status.

# Single closest event - platform proximity function

Slight modifications to the function provided by Dave Fifield, built for Sydney Collins thesis at Memorial University.

This function finds the single closest approach of a foraging track to a point within a set of points provided by the user - in this case offshore petroleum facilities.

We use only complete trips for this analysis

```{r ppx-function}

# Function to find the closest approach of a single track (trk) to a set of points (pnts).
#
# Implements both the "closest track point" and "closest trackline location" methods.
#
# Inputs:
#   trk - dataframe with at least columns ID, BirdID, lon, lat. The rows are consecutive
#         positions for a single track from a single animal.
#   pnts - dataframe of fixed points with columns: name, lon, lat, which represent fixed
#         objects (e.g., rigs)
#   plotit - (default TRUE) should a map be produced?
#
# Result:
#   Returns a single-row dataframe with columns:
#   ID - same as trk
#   BirdID - same as trk
#   point.dist - shortest distance between a **point** included in trk and the 
#     nearest point in pnts. 
#   point.rownum - the row number of the point closest to pnts.
#   point.lon - longitude of closest point in trk 
#   point.lat - latitude of closest point in trk 
#   point.pnt.name - name of the element of pnts that was closest to the track point
#   trk.dist - shortest distance between the **assumed track line** 
#     (i.e., assumed straight lines between points in trk) and the nearest point in pnts.
#   trk.lon - longitude of closest position along the trk line
#   trk.lat - latitude of closest position along the trk line
#   trk.pnt.name - name of the element of pnts that was closest to track line

findClosestDistance <- function(trk, pnts, plotit = TRUE) {
  
  res <- data.frame(colony = unique(trk$colony), ID = unique(trk$ID), BirdID = unique(trk$BirdID))
  
  # Method 1. Find distance from nearest element of pnts to a point in trk
  
  # Get distance between all track points and each point in pnts.
  dists <- spDists(cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat), cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), longlat = TRUE)
  
  # Get the row and column index of the minimum distance. Note the "[1,]" at the 
  # end is just in case there is more than one pnt equidistant from a trk point 
  # in which case we just choose the first one.
  min.element <- which(dists == min(dists), arr.ind = T)[1,]
  res %<>% mutate(point.dist = min(dists),
                  point.lat = trk[min.element["row"], "lat"],
                  point.lon = trk[min.element["row"], "lon"],
                  point.status = trk[min.element["row"], "status"],
                  point.datetime = trk[min.element["row"], "datetime"],
                  point.tod = trk[min.element["row"], "tod"],
                  point.states3 = trk[min.element["row"], "states3"],
                  point.statesAW = trk[min.element["row"], "statesAW"],
                  point.rownum = min.element["row"],
                  point.pnt.name = pnts$name[min.element["col"]],
                  point.pnt.name = pnts$name[min.element["col"]])
  
  # Method 2. Find distance from track line to nearest element of pnts 

  # Get distance from each pnt to the track
  dists = dist2Line(cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat))
  min.row <- which.min(dists[, "distance"])
  res %<>% mutate(trk.dist = dists[min.row, "distance"]/1000,
                  trk.lat = dists[min.row, "lat"],
                  trk.lon = dists[min.row, "lon"],
                  trk.pnt.name = pnts$name[min.row])
  
  # plot trk
  if (plotit) {
    cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat) %>% 
      makeLine() %>% 
      plot(type = "l", 
           main = paste0(as.character(res$ID), 
             ", Point: ", res$point.pnt.name, ", ",round(res$point.dist, 1), " km",
             ", Trackline: ", res$trk.pnt.name, ", ",round(res$trk.dist, 1), " km"),
           xlim = range(c(trk$lon, pnts$lon)), 
           ylim = range(c(trk$lat, pnts$lat)))
    points(cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat))
    
    # plot pnts
    points(cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), col = 'blue', pch = 20)
    
    # line between closest track point to closest pnt
    points(res$point.lon, res$point.lat, col = "red")
    lines(c(res$point.lon, pnts$lon[which(pnts$name == res$point.pnt.name)]), 
          c(res$point.lat, pnts$lat[which(pnts$name == res$point.pnt.name)]), col = "red")
    
    # Line of between closest track-line location and pnt
    points(res$trk.lon, res$trk.lat, col = "blue", pch = "x")
    lines(c(res$trk.lon, pnts$lon[which(pnts$name == res$trk.pnt.name)]), 
          c(res$trk.lat, pnts$lat[which(pnts$name == res$trk.pnt.name)]), col = "blue")
  }
  
  return(res)
}

```

##Read data

Omit incomplete trips to assess the closest passage per trip on trips known to be complete.

```{r}

# Load HMM data/tracks
trk <- readRDS(here::here("input_data/HMM_classified_data.rds")) |>
  dplyr::filter(trip_typeBasic != "incomplete trip") |>
  dplyr::select(colonyBasic, ID, birdID, datetime, night_day_dd, Longitude, Latitude, sex, statusBasic, trip_typeBasic, states3_cov, states3_cov_te.i) |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = Longitude,
                lat = Latitude, 
                BirdID = birdID,
                states3 = states3_cov,
                statesAW = states3_cov_te.i,
                tripType = trip_typeBasic,
                tod = night_day_dd,
                colony = colonyBasic,
                status = statusBasic)

# Load platform locations  
pnts <- read.csv(here::here("raw_data/threats/threats_offshorePetro_productionInstallationPts.csv")) |>
  rename(name = ID) |>
  select(name, lat, lon)

```

## Run function for each trip

```{r ppx-run}

# Call findClosestDistance() repeatedly, once for each GPS track.
# Each row in the resulting "dists" corresponds to a single track from gps.

# Format to use parallel processing 
myCluster <- makeCluster(15)
registerDoParallel(myCluster)

outList <- foreach(i = 1:length(unique(trk$ID))) %dopar% {
  
  gc()
  
  library(sf)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(geosphere)
  library(sp)
  library(magrittr)
  
  trip <- unique(trk$ID)[i]
  
  findClosestDistance(trk = trk[which(trk$ID == trip),], pnts = pnts, plotit = FALSE)
  
}

stopCluster(myCluster)

# Collapse list to single dataframe
out <- dplyr::bind_rows(outList)

saveRDS(out, here::here("output_data/platform_proximity/PlatformProximity_closestPass_byTrip.rds"))

```

## Summarize closest passage distance

```{r, nbirds}

# Use track distance for distance (point.dist)
# and point for behavioural state (trk.dist)

# Summarize closest passage by colony and breeding stage
# mean, se, min closest pass distance

# Trips
sumCol_trips <- out |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            meanDist = mean(trk.dist),
            seDist = sd(trk.dist)/sqrt(n),
            minDist = min(trk.dist))

sumColStatus_trips <- out |>
  group_by(colony, point.status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            meanDist = mean(trk.dist),
            seDist = sd(trk.dist)/sqrt(n),
            minDist = min(trk.dist))

# Birds
sumCol_birds <- out |>
  group_by(BirdID) |>
  slice_min(trk.dist, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            meanDist = mean(trk.dist),
            seDist = sd(trk.dist)/sqrt(n),
            minDist = min(trk.dist),
            .groups = "drop_last") 

sumColStatus_birds <- out |>
  group_by(BirdID) |>
  slice_min(trk.dist, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(colony, point.status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            meanDist = mean(trk.dist),
            seDist = sd(trk.dist)/sqrt(n),
            minDist = min(trk.dist),
            .groups = "drop_last") 

```

# Multiple Exposures: Close-Passage Threshold Function

For the exposure summary, we want to determine all the trips/birds that pass within the NS or NL light footprints or the theoretical oil footprint. The single closest passage point from the function above might not be the only one within these footprints. In cases where more than one point or passage occurs in the footprints, all these points/passages should be checked for behavioural state and time of day to determine exposure. To do this, we use the state of the point if a point falls within the footprint, or the state of the closest point if only the trackline falls within the footprint. Multiple passages are especially likely for Country Island birds.

For this analysis, we want to use ALL trips, not just the complete ones - including any evidence of exposure if it is present in the available data.

## Re-read data with all trips

```{r load-dat}

# Load HMM data/tracks, keep all trips (including incomplete)
trk <- readRDS(here::here("input_data/HMM_classified_data.rds")) |>
  dplyr::select(colonyBasic, ID, birdID, datetime, night_day_dd, Longitude, Latitude, sex, statusBasic, trip_typeBasic, states3_cov, states3_cov_te.i) |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = Longitude,
                lat = Latitude, 
                BirdID = birdID,
                states3 = states3_cov,
                statesAW = states3_cov_te.i,
                tripType = trip_typeBasic,
                tod = night_day_dd,
                colony = colonyBasic,
                status = statusBasic)

```

Define the revised function:

```{r ppx-function}

# Function to find the all locations in a single track (trk) within a given distance threshold of a set of points (pnts).
#
# Implements both the "closest track point" and "closest trackline location" methods.
# For cases where the trackline is closest, characteristics (e.g. time of day, HMM state) are obtained from the nearest track point
#
# Inputs:
#   trk - dataframe with at least columns ID, BirdID, lon, lat. The rows are consecutive
#         positions for a single track from a single animal.
#   pnts - dataframe of fixed points with columns: name, lon, lat, which represent fixed
#         objects (e.g., rigs)
#   thresh - distance threshold in meters (radius of threat footprint) to retain close passage record
#   plotit - (default TRUE) should a map be produced?
#   plotdir - directory in which to save the plot
#
# Result:
#   Returns a dataframe with one row per line/point that is within the threshold distance of a pnts location with columns:
#   ID - same as trk
#   BirdID - same as trk
#   point.dist - shortest distance between a **point** included in trk and the 
#     nearest point in pnts. 
#   point.rownum - the row number of the point closest to pnts.
#   point.lon - longitude of closest point in trk 
#   point.lat - latitude of closest point in trk 
#   point.pnt.name - name of the element of pnts that was closest to the track point
#   trk.dist - shortest distance between the **assumed track line** 
#     (i.e., assumed straight lines between points in trk) and the nearest point in pnts.
#   trk.lon - longitude of closest position along the trk line
#   trk.lat - latitude of closest position along the trk line
#   trk.pnt.name - name of the element of pnts that was closest to track line
#   min.dist - shortest distance from the trackline or points method
#   within.point - T/F was the point within the threshold distance?
#   within.trackline - T/F was the closest point along the trackline within the threshold distance?

findThresholdRecords <- function(trk, pnts, thresh, plotit = TRUE, plotdir = NULL) {
  
  # Method 1. Distance from each trk point to each pnt
  dists1 <- spDists(cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat), cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), longlat = TRUE)
  
  # Method 2. Distance from each pnt to the trackline
  dists2 <- suppressWarnings(
    dist2Line(cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat))
  )
  dists2.km <- dists2[, "distance"] / 1000
  
  # --- Method 1 rows: one per trk point within thresh of any pnt ---
  # Find row/col indices where distance <= thresh
  within1 <- which(dists1 <= thresh, arr.ind = TRUE)  # row = trk index, col = pnt index
  
  if (nrow(within1) > 0) {
    res1 <- data.frame(
      colony         = trk$colony[within1[, "row"]],
      ID             = trk$ID[within1[, "row"]],
      BirdID         = trk$BirdID[within1[, "row"]],
      point.pnt.name = pnts$name[within1[, "col"]],
      point.dist     = dists1[within1],
      point.lat      = trk$lat[within1[, "row"]],
      point.lon      = trk$lon[within1[, "row"]],
      point.status   = trk$status[within1[, "row"]],
      point.datetime = trk$datetime[within1[, "row"]],
      point.tod      = trk$tod[within1[, "row"]],
      point.states3  = trk$states3[within1[, "row"]],
      point.statesAW = trk$statesAW[within1[, "row"]],
      point.rownum   = within1[, "row"],
      trk.dist       = NA,
      trk.lat        = NA,
      trk.lon        = NA,
      method         = "point",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    res1 <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # --- Method 2 rows: one per pnt where trackline passes within thresh ---
  pnts.within.trackline <- which(dists2.km <= thresh)
  
  if (length(pnts.within.trackline) > 0) {
    res2.list <- lapply(pnts.within.trackline, function(p) {
      
      # Assign point.* columns from nearest trk point to the trackline location
      trk.loc <- c(dists2[p, "lon"], dists2[p, "lat"])
      trk.dists.to.loc <- spDists(cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat), 
                                   matrix(trk.loc, nrow = 1), 
                                   longlat = TRUE)
      nearest.row <- which.min(trk.dists.to.loc)
      
      data.frame(
        colony         = trk$colony[1],
        ID             = trk$ID[1],
        BirdID         = trk$BirdID[1],
        point.pnt.name = pnts$name[p],
        point.dist     = min(dists1[, p]),  # nearest trk point to this pnt
        point.lat      = trk$lat[nearest.row],
        point.lon      = trk$lon[nearest.row],
        point.status   = trk$status[nearest.row],
        point.datetime = trk$datetime[nearest.row],
        point.tod      = trk$tod[nearest.row],
        point.states3  = trk$states3[nearest.row],
        point.statesAW = trk$statesAW[nearest.row],
        point.rownum   = nearest.row,
        trk.dist       = dists2.km[p],
        trk.lat        = dists2[p, "lat"],
        trk.lon        = dists2[p, "lon"],
        method         = "trackline",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    res2 <- do.call(rbind, res2.list)
  } else {
    res2 <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # Combine both methods
  res <- bind_rows(res1, res2)
  
  if (nrow(res) == 0) {
    message("No pnts found within threshold distance via either method.")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # Minimum distance across both methods
  res$min.dist <- pmin(res$point.dist, res$trk.dist, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (plotit & !is.null(plotdir)) {
    
    if (!dir.exists(plotdir)) dir.create(plotdir, recursive = TRUE)
    
    trip <- unique(trk$ID)[1]
    png(file.path(plotdir, paste0(trip, ".png")),
        width = 1920, height = 1080, res = 150)
    
    cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat) %>%
      makeLine() %>%
      plot(type = "l",
           main = paste0(trip, " — pnts within ", thresh, " km"),
           xlim = range(c(trk$lon, pnts$lon)),
           ylim = range(c(trk$lat, pnts$lat)))
    points(cbind(trk$lon, trk$lat))
    points(cbind(pnts$lon, pnts$lat), col = 'blue', pch = 20)
    
    # Orange: Method 1 rows
    res1.plot <- res[res$method == "point", ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(res1.plot))) {
      pnt.match <- which(pnts$name == res1.plot$point.pnt.name[i])
      points(res1.plot$point.lon[i], res1.plot$point.lat[i], col = "red")
      lines(c(res1.plot$point.lon[i], pnts$lon[pnt.match]),
            c(res1.plot$point.lat[i], pnts$lat[pnt.match]), col = "red")
    }
    
    # Blue: Method 2 rows
    res2.plot <- res[res$method == "trackline", ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(res2.plot))) {
      pnt.match <- which(pnts$name == res2.plot$point.pnt.name[i])
      points(res2.plot$trk.lon[i], res2.plot$trk.lat[i], col = "blue", pch = 4)
      lines(c(res2.plot$trk.lon[i], pnts$lon[pnt.match]),
            c(res2.plot$trk.lat[i], pnts$lat[pnt.match]), col = "blue")
    }
    
    legend("bottomright",
           legend = c("O&G facilities", "trk point in thresh", "nearest pnt on trackline"),
           col    = c("blue", "red", "blue"),
           pch    = c(20, 1, 4),
           lty    = c(NA, 1, 1))
    
    dev.off()
  }
  
  return(res)
}

```

## Run function for each trip 

We use the hypothetical oil footprint (8km) as the threshold. This is larger than the light footprints so we can extract the light exposures from the results after the function has run (consider only passages within 1.2 km for NS, 5.3 km for NL).

```{r ppx-run-oil}

# Call findThresholdRecords() repeatedly, once for each GPS track.

myCluster <- makeCluster(20)
registerDoParallel(myCluster)

outList <- foreach(i = 1:length(unique(trk$ID))) %dopar% {
  
  gc()
  
  library(sf)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(geosphere)
  library(sp)
  library(magrittr)
  
  trip <- unique(trk$ID)[i]

  result <- tryCatch(
  findThresholdRecords(trk = trk[which(trk$ID == trip),], pnts = pnts, thresh = 8, plotit = TRUE, plotdir = here::here("output_data/platform_proximity/8km-threshold-plots")),
  error = function(e) {
      message("Error for ID: ", trip, " — ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )

  result
  
}

stopCluster(myCluster)

# Collapse list to single dataframe
out <- dplyr::bind_rows(outList)

saveRDS(out, here::here("output_data/platform_proximity/PlatformProximity_allRecordsInOilFootprint_8km.rds"))

```

## Birds exposed to oil

Summarize proportion in the oil footprint vs exposed (in oil footprint in 'on-water'/foraging behavioural state) separately.

```{r}

# Percentage, all states
bird.status <- trk |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(nBirds = length(unique(BirdID)))

# Proportions in oil footprint and exposed
oilFP <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(nBirds_oilFP = length(unique(BirdID)),
            .groups = "drop_last")

oilExp <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  filter(point.statesAW == "Foraging") |>    #Reduce to records when on-water
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(nBirds_oilExp = length(unique(BirdID)),
            .groups = "drop_last")

exposures <- left_join(bird.status, oilFP, by = c("colony", "status")) |>
  mutate(pBirds_oilFP = nBirds_oilFP/nBirds) |>
  left_join(oilExp, by = c("colony", "status")) |>
  mutate(pBirds_oilExp = nBirds_oilExp/nBirds)

```

## Birds exposed to light

Reduce to records within light footprint. Allow for differences in the average light footprint at NL and former NS facilities. Then reduce to records within these light footprints at night.

Summarize proportion in the light footprint vs exposed (in light footprint at night) separately.

```{r}

# Different size light footprints for NS and NL colonies
# Use average light basin size for NS and NL from Gjerdrum et al. 2021
# Light basin: 1.2 km for NS, 5.3 km for NL

rad.light.NL <- sqrt(((86+59+123)/3)/pi)
rad.light.NS <- sqrt(((2+14+1+5+1)/5)/pi)

# All trips in light FP at any time of day
out <- out |>
  mutate(platRegion = ifelse(point.pnt.name %in% c("SeaRose FPSO", "Hibernia Platform", "Terra Nova FPSO", "Hebron Platform"), "NL", "NS"),
         inLFP = ifelse(platRegion == "NL" & min.dist <= rad.light.NL, "yes",
                       ifelse(platRegion == "NS" & min.dist <= rad.light.NS, "yes", "no")))

lightFP <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  filter(inLFP == "yes") |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(nBirds_lightFP = length(unique(BirdID)),
            .groups = "drop_last")

lightExp <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  filter(inLFP == "yes" & point.tod == "night") |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(nBirds_lightExp = length(unique(BirdID)),
            .groups = "drop_last")

exposures <- exposures |>
  left_join(lightFP, by = c("colony", "status")) |>
  mutate(pBirds_lightFP = nBirds_lightFP/nBirds) |>
  left_join(lightExp, by = c("colony", "status")) |>
  mutate(pBirds_lightExp = nBirds_lightExp/nBirds)

```

### Save exposure summary

```{r}

saveRDS(exposures, here::here("output_data/platform_proximity/PlatformProximity_byBird_allExposures.rds"))
write.csv(exposures, here::here("output_data/platform_proximity/PlatformProximity_byBird_allExposures.csv"), row.names = F)

```

## Multiple exposures per trip

Identify birds with more than one close passage or exposure per trip. Summarize the mean number of exposures per trip by colony and breeding stage.

```{r}

# Add column to indicate exposure type
out <- out |>
  mutate(lightExp = ifelse(inLFP == "yes" & point.tod == "night", "yes", "no"),
         oilExp = ifelse(point.statesAW == "Foraging", "yes", "no")) |>
  arrange(ID, point.datetime, point.pnt.name)
  
out <- out |> 
  group_by(ID, point.pnt.name, point.datetime) |>
  slice_min(min.dist, n = 1, with_ties = T)

# Add whether trip is complete or not
trips <- trk |>
  select(ID, tripType) |>
  distinct()
  
out <- left_join(out, trips, by = "ID")

# Number of exposures per trip - all trips
nExp_trip <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  group_by(colony, status, ID) |>
  summarize(nTrip_OFP = n(),
            nTrip_lightExp = sum(lightExp == "yes"),
            nTrip_LFP = sum(inLFP == "yes"),
            nTrip_oilExp = sum(lightExp == "yes"),
            .groups = "drop_last")

# Mean number of exposures per trip
mean_OFP <- nExp_trip |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(nTrip_OFP),
            min = min(nTrip_OFP),
            max = max(nTrip_OFP),
            SE = sd(nTrip_OFP)/sqrt(n))
 
mean_oilExp <- nExp_trip |>
  filter(nTrip_oilExp > 0) |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(nTrip_oilExp),
            min = min(nTrip_oilExp),
            max = max(nTrip_oilExp),
            SE = sd(nTrip_oilExp)/sqrt(n))

mean_LFP <- nExp_trip |>
  filter(nTrip_LFP > 0) |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(nTrip_LFP),
            min = min(nTrip_LFP),
            max = max(nTrip_LFP),
            SE = sd(nTrip_LFP)/sqrt(n))

mean_lightExp <- nExp_trip |>
  filter(nTrip_lightExp > 0) |>
  group_by(colony, status) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(nTrip_lightExp),
            min = min(nTrip_lightExp),
            max = max(nTrip_lightExp),
            SE = sd(nTrip_lightExp)/sqrt(n))

# Check: are there trips where a bird is exposed to both light and oil, in different instants?
tt <- out |>
  rename(status = point.status) |>
  group_by(colony, status, ID) |>
  summarize(nLight = sum(lightExp == "yes"),
            nOil = sum(oilExp == "yes"),
            nBoth = sum(lightExp == "yes" & oilExp == "yes"))
# Only one case of both and only one record each for light and oil in that case.

```

## Number of exposed trips per bird

Get number of exposures per trip, then numer of exposed trips per bird. 

For exposed birds, also calculate the proportion of their trips on which they experienced exposures.

Use complete trips only for this assessment.

```{r}

# Get number of exposures per complete trip
tripsExp <- out |>
  filter(tripType != "incomplete trip") |>
  group_by(BirdID, ID) |>
  summarize(nOFP = n(),
            nOilExp = sum(oilExp == "yes"),
            nLFP = sum(inLFP == "yes"),
            nLightExp = sum(lightExp == "yes"))

# Get number of exposed trips per bird
birdsExp <- tripsExp |>
  group_by(BirdID) |>
  summarize(nOFP = sum(nOFP > 0),
            nOilExp = sum(nOilExp > 0),
            nLFP = sum(nLFP > 0),
            nLightExp = sum(nLightExp >0))

# Compare to number of complete trips for that bird
trips_complete <- trk |>
  select(colony, BirdID, ID, tripType) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(tripType != "incomplete trip")

tripsPerBird <- trips_complete |>
  group_by(colony, BirdID) |>
  summarize(totalTrips = n())

birdsExp <- birdsExp |>
  left_join(tripsPerBird, by = "BirdID") |>
  mutate(pOFP = nOFP/totalTrips,
         pOilExp = nOilExp/totalTrips,
         pLFP = nLFP/totalTrips,
         pLightExp = nLightExp/totalTrips)

sumBirdsExp_pOFP <- birdsExp |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(pOFP),
            sem = sd(pOFP)/sqrt(n()),
            n = n())

sumBirdsExp_pLFP <- birdsExp |>
  filter(nLFP > 0) |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(pLFP),
            sem = sd(pLFP)/sqrt(n()),
            n = n())

sumBirdsExp_pLightExp <- birdsExp |>
  filter(nLightExp > 0) |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(pLightExp),
            sem = sd(pLightExp)/sqrt(n()),
            n = n())

sumBirdsExp_pOilExp <- birdsExp |>
  filter(nOilExp > 0) |>
  group_by(colony) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(pOilExp),
            sem = sd(pOilExp)/sqrt(n()),
            n = n())

```
